title: asterisk is icon not label text
rule: Required marker uses a spaced icon. If you use an asterisk, include hint text that explains what it means. Never use an asterisk to mark optional.
pass_when: Required is a spaced icon (not asterisk characters inside the label string); hint text explains the marker; optional is not marked with an asterisk.
fail_when: Asterisk is typed as label text; no explanation of the marker; or asterisk marks optional.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) or Fluent all-required-one-instruction. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`. Overlap with extra 73: `fluent.required-asterisk-or-one-instruction`.
